playlist.name: Paul van Dyk VONYC Sessions Essentials
playlist.desc: Your weekly dose of Paul van Dyk's radio show VONYC Sessions - a 2hr show and the ultimate listening pleasure for lovers of superior electronic dance music, embracing genres from trance to electro, house, progressive, techno and dance. For more info about the globally-syndicated show, visit www.REDACTED.com
